items.title: Smoothness pulls back along etale morphisms: X -> Z smooth and Y -> Z etale imply X -> Y smooth
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a composition X -> Y -> Z with X -> Z smooth and Y -> Z etale, the lemma concludes X -> Y is smooth. The proof runs the naive cotangent complex criterion step by step, each step with a named citation: local finite presentation by permanence, vanishing of H^{-1} and finite local freeness of Omega for the smooth map, the two-fold vanishing for the etale map, the six-term sequence giving H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) = 0 and Omega_{X/Y} congruent to Omega_{X/Z} finite locally free, and finally the NL criterion for smoothness. Retained author proof at lines 3966-3977.
